utterance: The shared `platform-vpc` is the only network this account has cut so far. The storefront web tier needs one of its own: create a VPC with a CIDR block and DNS hostnames enabled, and an internet gateway attached to it. Name-tag the VPC `vpc` and the gateway `ig`.

main.responsibility: owns the application's resources and their configuration
main.intent: the storefront web tier has a VPC of its own, tagged Name=vpc, with DNS hostnames enabled and a CIDR block that no other network in the account holds or has reserved, and an internet gateway tagged Name=ig attached to that VPC
